issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The edit only adds 5 standard RDKit descriptors (MolWt, LogP, HBD, HBA, TPSA), computed from each molecule's own SMILES. It reads no files and does not use test labels.
No bug that would make the result meaningless. Train and test molecules go through the same featurize code, and all five descriptors are defined for any molecule RDKit can parse.

The incumbent mean comes from a single run, so the comparison is weak and z is just under 2. A replicate of the incumbent, or one more candidate run, would make the decision firmer.
